Label: Empathy Quotient - 10 items
Description: Empathy Quotient - 10 items (EQ-10). Measures trait empathy (cognitive and affective components). 10 items, scored 0-2 (keying differs across items). Reference: Baron-Cohen, S., & Wheelwright, S. (2004). The empathy quotient: An investigation of adults with Asperger syndrome or high functioning autism, and normal sex differences. Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders, 34(2), 163-175.
